name: HandBrake Converter
description: Re-encodes library videos with HandBrake on a schedule.
overview: Re-encodes library videos with HandBrake on a schedule.

versions.changelog: Subtitles: keep only chosen languages plus forced tracks, convert text subtitles to SRT, and fix subtitles alone on already-converted files without re-encoding the video. Queue: each Auto-convert library is one row in the ordered list so manual jobs and automatic libraries can be mixed in any order, plus a Stop automatic and start now button.
